verdict.rationale: sevDesk is accounting software, so a month-end close checklist is a fair question for it. The evidence shows only adjacent features: matching invoices to bank payments, a trial balance and tax-adviser collaboration. Nothing documents a close checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals or review sign-offs.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can run a month-end close against a checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals, and review sign-offs
